lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਵਡਾ ਤੂੰ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) vadaa too(n) oocho oochaa ||
lines.translation: You are so Great! You are the Highest of the High!

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਅਤਿ ਮੂਚੋ ਮੂਚਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) bea(n)t at moocho moochaa ||
lines.translation: You are Infinite, You are Everything!

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਤੇਰੈ ਵੰਞਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੩੫॥
lines.transliteration: hau kurabaanee terai va(n)njaa naanak daas dasaavaniaa ||8||1||35||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to You. Nanak is the slave of Your slaves. ||8||1||35||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaun s mukataa kaun s jugataa ||
lines.translation: Who is liberated, and who is united?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਬਕਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaun s giaanee kaun s bakataa ||
lines.translation: Who is a spiritual teacher, and who is a preacher?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kaun s girahee kaun udaasee kaun s keemat paae jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: Who is a house-holder, and who is a renunciate? Who can estimate the Lord's Value? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਾਧਾ ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਛੂਟਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kin bidh baadhaa kin bidh chhootaa ||
lines.translation: How is one bound, and how is one freed of his bonds?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਤੂਟਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kin bidh aavan jaavan tootaa ||
lines.translation: How can one escape from the cycle of coming and going in reincarnation?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਣ ਕਰਮ ਕਉਣ ਨਿਹਕਰਮਾ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kaun karam kaun nihakaramaa kaun s kahai kahaae jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: Who is subject to karma, and who is beyond karma? Who chants the Name, and inspires others to chant it? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਦੁਖੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaun s sukheeaa kaun s dukheeaa ||
lines.translation: Who is happy, and who is sad?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਵੇਮੁਖੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaun s sanamukh kaun vemukheeaa ||
lines.translation: Who, as sunmukh, turns toward the Guru, and who, as vaymukh, turns away from the Guru?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਛੁਰੈ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਉਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kin bidh mileeai kin bidh bichhurai ih bidh kaun pragataae jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: How can one meet the Lord? How is one separated from Him? Who can reveal the way to me? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਅਖਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਹਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaun s akhar jit dhaavat rahataa ||
lines.translation: What is that Word, by which the wandering mind can be restrained?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਸਹਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaun upades jit dukh sukh sam sahataa ||
lines.translation: What are those teachings, by which we may endure pain and pleasure alike?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁ ਚਾਲ ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਕਿਨਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: kaun s chaal jit paarabraham dhiaae kin bidh keeratan gaae jeeu ||4||
lines.translation: What is that lifestyle, by which we may come to meditate on the Supreme Lord? How may we sing the Kirtan of His Praises? ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh mukataa guramukh jugataa ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh is liberated, and the Gurmukh is linked.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਕਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh giaanee guramukh bakataa ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh is the spiritual teacher, and the Gurmukh is the preacher.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n girahee udaasee guramukh guramukh keemat paae jeeu ||5||
lines.translation: Blessed is the Gurmukh, the householder and the renunciate. The Gurmukh knows the Lord's Value. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਬਾਧਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਛੂਟਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai baadhaa guramukh chhootaa ||
lines.translation: Egotism is bondage; as Gurmukh, one is emancipated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਵਣੁ ਤੂਟਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh aavan jaavan tootaa ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh escapes the cycle of coming and going in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਮ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਹਕਰਮਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh karam guramukh nihakaramaa guramukh kare s subhaae jeeu ||6||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh performs actions of good karma, and the Gurmukh is beyond karma. Whatever the Gurmukh does, is done in good faith. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sukheeaa manamukh dukheeaa ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh is happy, while the self-willed manmukh is sad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਮੁਖੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sanamukh manamukh vemukheeaa ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh turns toward the Guru, and the self-willed manmukh turns away from the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਛੁਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh mileeai manamukh vichhurai guramukh bidh pragataae jeeu ||7||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh is united with the Lord, while the manmukh is separated from Him. The Gurmukh reveals the way. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਖਰੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਰਹਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh akhar jit dhaavat rahataa ||
lines.translation: The Guru's Instruction is the Word, by which the wandering mind is restrained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਸਹਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh upades dukh sukh sam sahataa ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, we can endure pain and pleasure alike.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਲ ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh chaal jit paarabraham dhiaae guramukh keeratan gaae jeeu ||8||
lines.translation: To live as Gurmukh is the lifestyle by which we come to meditate on the Supreme Lord. The Gurmukh sings the Kirtan of His Praises. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ਆਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagalee banat banaaee aape ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself created the entire creation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ਥਾਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape kare karaae thaape ||
lines.translation: He Himself acts, and causes others to act. He Himself establishes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੁ ਤੇ ਹੋਇਓ ਅਨੰਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੯॥੨॥੩੬॥
lines.transliteration: ikas te hoio ana(n)taa naanak ekas maahi samaae jeeu ||9||2||36||
lines.translation: From oneness, He has brought forth the countless multitudes. O Nanak, they shall merge into the One once again. ||9||2||36||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਾੜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh abinaasee taa kiaa kaaRaa ||
lines.translation: God is Eternal and Imperishable, so why should anyone be anxious?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵੰਤਾ ਤਾ ਜਨੁ ਖਰਾ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bhagava(n)taa taa jan kharaa sukhaalaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord is Wealthy and Prosperous, so His humble servant should feel totally secure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jee praan maan sukhadaataa too(n) karahi soee sukh paavaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: O Giver of peace of the soul, of life, of honor-as You ordain, I obtain peace. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree guramukh man tan bhaavaniaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to that Gurmukh whose mind and body are pleased with You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਰਬਤੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੇਰਾ ਓਲਾ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) meraa parabat too(n) meraa olaa tum sa(n)g lavai na laavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You are my mountain, You are my shelter and shield. No one can rival You. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa keetaa jis laagai meethaa ||
lines.translation: That person, unto whom Your actions seem sweet,

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghat paarabraham tin jan deethaa ||
lines.translation: comes to see the Supreme Lord God in each and every heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਾਨਿ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਇਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: thaan thana(n)tar too(n)hai too(n)hai iko ik varataavaniaa ||2||
lines.translation: In all places and interspaces, You exist. You are the One and Only Lord, pervading everywhere. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal manorath too(n) devanahaaraa ||
lines.translation: You are the Fulfiller of all the mind's desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੀ ਭਾਇ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagatee bhaai bhare bha(n)daaraa ||
lines.translation: Your treasures are overflowing with love and devotion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਈ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: daiaa dhaar raakhe tudh seee poorai karam samaavaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: Showering Your Mercy, You protect those who, through perfect destiny, merge into You. ||3||
